events.description:
Curious about the big questions of life, faith, and meaning? Join us for the 3-2-1 Course!

It is a welcoming, open space to explore the Christian faith, making it the perfect opportunity to investigate for yourself or bring a friend along.

Together, we will look at what Jesus says about God, the world and our purpose in it.

events.title: Brick Club
events.description:
Looking for a fun, affordable way to connect with your kids after school? Bring the whole family to the Big Sports Hall at the Community Centre every Tuesday during term time from 3:30 PM to 4:30 PM!

This is an interactive group where parents and primary school children (Reception/Year 0 to Year 6) team up!

Together, we will explore a great Bible story, enjoy some tasty snacks and drinks, and take on epic Lego team-building challenges. Come explore faith, build cool creations, and spend quality time together.

events.title: Men's Fire Night
events.description:
Come along and gather around the fire for a relaxed evening together.

Good conversation. Good company. Good food.

Burger and beer provided.

Bring a mate and join us around the fire.

For men aged 16+ (U18's must be accompanied by a parent or carer).
